chart.compilation_note: All backends measured in the same cohort.
chart.runtime_note: Preparation, warmups and startup excluded. Native reference repeated in both panels.

method: One fresh same-host cohort measures all three backends with the same current compiler and adapted sources. Backends are not interleaved pairs. Direct Wasm is memory32; C-to-Wasm is memory64. Native reference is repeated in both engine panels. All seven direct modules are byte-identical to the preceding cohort; no kernel gain is attributed to the resource-free call-graph proof.
